llm.summary: The skill's code and instructions are consistent with an Nginx configuration generator: it contains only a small bash wrapper that emits prompt templates and no network, credential, or filesystem access beyond standard output.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (Nginx config, reverse proxy, SSL, caching, security, optimization) align with the provided files: SKILL.md describes those features and nginx.sh provides command-based prompt templates for those topics. There are no unrelated requirements (no cloud creds, no unrelated binaries).
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md is an instruction-only guide focused on config generation. The runtime script (nginx.sh) only prints localized prompt templates and any user input; it does not read system files, environment variables, or send data externally. No steps request gathering unrelated system context.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec and the only code file is a small shell script. Nothing is downloaded or written to disk during install. Risk from install mechanism is minimal.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables, credentials, or config paths. The script does not access any secrets or external services, so its requested environment access is proportionate.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not always-on and does not request persistent system privileges or modify other skills or global agent settings. Autonomous invocation is allowed by default (normal), but the skill itself does not escalate privileges.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and lightweight: it provides prompt templates for generating Nginx configurations and includes no network calls or secret access. Before applying any generated config to production, review and test it in a staging environment. Also note the package source/homepage is unspecified in the metadata — if you require provenance, verify the author (BytesAgain) and review any updates before trusting configs for critical systems. Avoid pasting private keys or credentials into the tool's prompts.
